title: xte W4: prove pi's cloudflare-workers-ai provider reaches Workers AI through the metered gateway, not api.cloudflare.com
body: Parent xte. The review found that pi-ai hard-codes the Cloudflare accounts URL, needs CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and ignores WORKERS_AI_BASE_URL, so a worker either fails its first call or sends the run token straight to Cloudflare (finding a6d74684). ha9/qu3 landed pi and its spelling upstream, but nothing on this branch shows the gateway leg. Needs a provider override and a live probe, not an export-only test.
